checks: unavailable purchased coverage creates neither an order nor a credit reservation
failure after SQL acceptance but before commit rolls back the newly created order, reservation and cascading events
altered price, foreign case/identity, actual web access and all non-worker function ACLs are refused
different quotes racing for one initial credit create exactly one full order; the losing insert rolls back
concurrent exact retries after response loss return one saved order and do not duplicate either event
a different quote for an existing purchased scope cannot silently reprice, cancel or replace that order
two first acceptances of the same unreserved quote create one order and one zero-credit reservation
synthetic paid v2 order starts a business clock without human attestation; historical v1 retains its human clock
changed source rejects unpaid retry while exact paid replay preserves purchased history
quote acceptance alone grants no entitlement and invokes no payment provider
scope: Actual worker/peer/web roles; injected synthetic monetary basis and synthetic verified payment row. No canonical monetary proof, provider payment, customer checkout or production change.
